language_requirement: «Para estudiantes de países de habla no hispana se requiere Acreditación B2 de español (a través de un Diploma de Español como Lengua Extranjera en un nivel de B2, o en su caso, prueba oral y escrita)». A DELE B2 in Spanish is therefore a formal admission requirement for this candidate. English at B1+ counts only as a minor admission merit (5% band).
tuition_year_of_rates: 2026-27. Anexo I item 2.2 of Decreto 101/2024 (DOGV 9913, 12/08/2024) sets «Estudios de máster no comprendidos en el grupo anterior» at 35,34 EUR/crédito, 1a matrícula; Decreto 122/2026, de 4 de agosto, del Consell modifies Decreto 101/2024 and keeps the enrolment prices frozen for curso 2026-2027. The UV programme sheet shows the same 35,34 / 70,68 pair.
non_eu_surcharge: YES - EXPLICIT AND DOUBLE. The UV official data sheet publishes two credit prices side by side: «Precio del crédito primera matrícula: 35.34€» and «Estudiantes extranjeros no UE: 70.68€». Legal base: Decreto 101/2024, de 2 de agosto, del Consell, art. 6.1 - «Al estudiantado extranjero, que no tenga la condición de residente, excluidos los nacionales de Estados miembros de la Unión Europea ..., se le aplicará el doble de los precios públicos establecidos en el anexo I ..., sin que el precio correspondiente pueda exceder del cien por cien (100%) del coste del servicio académico». Art. 6.3 closes the escape route: «la autorización de estancia concedida a los estudiantes extranjeros de acuerdo con el Real decreto 557/2011 ... no equivaldrá a la condición de residentes» - a Spanish study visa does NOT make this candidate a resident. The 1.5x transitional rate in Disposición transitoria primera applied only to curso 2024-2025, so the full doubling applies now.
entry_requirements: «Se requiere formación previa de nivel grado o superior en áreas como: Matemáticas, Física, Ingenierías (Informática, Electrónica, Telecomunicación e Industriales), Economía, y Administración y Dirección de Empresas.» Candidates must show competence in mathematics and statistics, prior use of programming tools (R, C, Matlab, Python or similar) and knowledge of programming fundamentals and databases. 25 plazas. Admission is scored: adecuación al perfil de ingreso 50%, expediente académico 40%, experiencia profesional en análisis de datos 5%, otros méritos (titulaciones adicionales, idiomas B1+, seminarios) 5%. Spanish B2 accreditation required for applicants from non-Spanish-speaking countries.
accepts_engineering_background: EXPLICIT - «Ingenierías (Informática, ...)» is named in the recommended entry profile, and it is the 50%-weighted admission criterion.
complementary_credits_required: 0 (RUCT) at title level - the register records ects_complementos_formativos = 0. AT APPLICANT LEVEL the programme states: «Aquellos cuya formación previa sea insuficiente en los conocimientos requeridos deberán cursar complementos formativos establecidos en la memoria del programa» (section 4.6 of the memoria), judged by the Comisión Académica on mathematics/statistics/programming competence. So RUCT's 0 does NOT guarantee an applicant is exempt - this is one of the cases the brief warns about. A Software Engineering graduate would normally clear the programming test; the maths/statistics component is the one to evidence.
credit_recognition_available: NOT FOUND - no statement of advanced standing or reconocimiento de créditos for a 300-ECTS first degree on the programme, data-sheet or admission pages. The 300 ECTS is useful here only as surplus over the entry bar; the master remains 90 ECTS over two courses.
application_window_2027: 2026-27 calendar (published; 2027-28 NOT YET PUBLISHED as of 2026-08-25). Fase 1: 30 March - 21 April 2026, 23:59. Fase 2: 25 May - 16 June 2026, 14:00. Fase Extraordinaria: 22-31 July and 24 August - 2 September 2026, 23:59. Dates are NOT shifted forward a year - the September 2027 intake calendar is not out.
non_eu_early_round_advised: YES, urgently. A holder of a degree from outside the EHEA that is not homologated must pay a 155,22 EUR «estudio de equivalencia» fee and, critically, «Obtaining the equivalence resolution is a requirement for the evaluation of the pre-enrolment application» - the application is not even assessed until the equivalence resolution is issued. A Tunisian degree holder must therefore enter in Fase 1 (the March-April window) to leave time for that resolution.
admissions_contact_email: NOT FOUND - UV routes pre-enrolment queries through its «Support and Enquiries» web form rather than publishing an address. Programme director: Emilio Soria Olivas (ETSE-UV).
curriculum_summary: 90 ECTS over two academic years. RUCT breakdown: 65 obligatorios, 0 optativos, 10 prácticas externas, 15 TFM. Taught at the Escuela Técnica Superior de Ingeniería (ETSE-UV), Avenida de la Universitat s/n, 46100 Burjassot. The 10-ECTS compulsory external placement is unusual among Spanish data-science masters and is a real industry hook.
notable_faculty_or_lab: Director Emilio Soria Olivas (ETSE-UV; machine-learning / intelligent data analysis group IDAL). Escola Tècnica Superior d'Enginyeria.
industry_links: 10 ECTS of compulsory prácticas externas built into the title (RUCT), i.e. a mandatory company placement. Specific partner companies NOT FOUND on the pages read.
thesis_or_internship: Both: 10 ECTS prácticas externas + 15 ECTS Trabajo Fin de Máster.
